# Public Trade History

This file only includes trade history that is visible through public indexed posts or secondary public mentions.

It is not broker-confirmed statement data.

## Confidence Rules

- `medium`: the trader publicly states an entry zone, direction, outcome, or replay using trade records
- `low`: a third party references his trade history or screenshots, but the underlying records are not independently verified here
- `not-verifiable`: claim exists, but no public underlying record is accessible in the current fetch set

## What This Means For The Skill

When using this skill, preserve these trade-history-informed tendencies:

- think in zones, not exact tops and bottoms
- flip bias if the structure truly changes
- wait if no readable setup exists
- re-enter after loss when the same edge is still there
- use explicit invalidation rather than vague conviction
